title: ADR-0150 D4: record the type-class reading of epic ruling 6817768147 (overlay types refuse, sealed types decline a package-less row)
body:
domain:server#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVaKJ9TPfXPRhdqx3e

Follow-up of #32568 (PR #32741), from the epic red-line delta read (PR #32741 comment 6829339652, nit 4). Filed under the maintainer's rule of 2026-11-12 09:41Z: review findings get their own card, not another PR round. Parked with the epic's release-line ruling.

Blocked-by: #32568
Restart-when: the release that carries the epic #31527 release line is published (ruling on #31527, comment 6824949405)

## 维护者速读

- 改什么：ADR-0150 D4 只写了「两个包同名时无包行在精确地址 409」，没写专题裁定 6817768147 的按类型类别读法：可覆盖类型（email_template、dashboard、report、view、translation）409 列出全部持有者；封闭类型按 ADR-0126 Regime C 不采用无包行、返回持有包自己的条目。
- 为什么：#32568 的 action 两持有者 409 → 200 是凭裁定评论落的，ADR 正文没有这句；以后的声明与评审应能直接引 ADR。
- 风险：只改 ADR 文字（`docs/adr/**` 是 governed 面，Tier H，需人批）。
- 先看：`docs/adr/0150-*.md` 的 D4，裁定 6817768147（#32568 上）。
- 验证：D4 写明两类各自的答案并引裁定；与 #32566、#32568 的 pin 一致。
- 需要你做的：PR 开出后审批（ADR 改动）。

## Do

1. Add the type-class reading to ADR-0150 D4 as an amendment that cites ruling 6817768147 and ADR-0126 Regime C: overlay types refuse naming every holder; sealed managed types decline the package-less row at a holder's exact address and serve the holder's own item; the bare read of a two-holder name keeps its 409.
2. Note the declared widening this reading carries (#32568, `action` with two holders, 409 → 200 the holder's own item).

**Clause-②:** none (ADR prose). **Metadata-protocol:** none.
